candidates.title: Enhanced Code Quality Checker
candidates.goal: Create a tool to check code for common issues and suggest improvements based on coding standards.
success_criteria: Analyzes a sample code snippet and identifies common issues.
Suggests improvements for the identified issues.
Generates a report with the issues and suggestions.
candidates.first_action: Write a Python script that takes a sample code snippet as input, analyzes it for common issues such as unused variables, redundant code, and formatting errors, and outputs a report with identified issues and suggested improvements.

candidates.title: Numeric Data Validator
candidates.goal: Develop a function to validate numeric data against predefined criteria.
success_criteria: Takes a list of numeric data points as input.
Validates each data point against predefined criteria (e.g., range, type).
Returns a boolean indicating whether all data points are valid.
candidates.first_action: Write a Python function that takes a list of numeric data points and a range as input, checks if all data points fall within the specified range, and prints 'PASS' if all points are valid.
